review: Munnar tea gardens are breathtaking! Loved the misty mornings at Mattupetty dam.
Eravikulam park was amazing, spotted the rare Nilgiri Tahr! Highly recommend visiting in morning hours.
Edakkal caves trek was thrilling. The climate in Wayanad was super pleasant and soothing.
Banasura Sagar dam speedboating is a must-do activity when visiting Wayanad!
The backwater houseboat experience in Alleppey was serene and peaceful. Fantastic local seafood meal served on board.
Unique cliffside beach with wonderful sunset views. Surfing and cafes at Varkala North Cliff are amazing!
Fort Kochi Chinese fishing nets and colonial art cafes give a rich cultural vibe.
